# v0.6.0 — Reusable business imports

2026-09-10 (UTC) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/yyyz1011/sheetdelta/releases/tag/v0.6.0)

## Changes

Portable import templates, dictionary cleaning and batch validation. Pages content deployment no longer waits for HTTPS certificate issuance.

## Installation and upgrade

Install this version:

```sh
npm install sheetdelta-core@0.6.0
```

Review the [migration guide](../migration) and [related usage guide](../reusable-imports) before upgrading. This is a summary of released changes, not a claim of support for every Excel feature.
